scope: Prepare latest-main plus reviewed UI in own sibling, bounded native tests and read-only Tailnet manual-test instance; user guide. No production or main replacement.

snapshot.reference: Observed canonical policy and runtime observer; pinned main231ba3db and review6d15a6d3 combined only in own sibling.

criticality.rationale: Current manual acceptance is blocked by stale deployed surfaces.

stpa.rationale: Wrong-instance testing and uncontrolled exposure are credible unless origin, routes and target are checked.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 gives RPN36/F4: testing the wrong deployment can produce false evidence.

dependency.rationale: GUI and TUI manual acceptance depend on a current identified test instance.

impact.rationale: One critical UOS testing service and its operator workflow.

fmea_modes.cause: Static origins or stale runtime route the operator to an older service.
fmea_modes.effect: Incorrect manual acceptance or unintended production interaction.
fmea_modes.controls: Explicit candidate, same-origin links, restricted test routes, new unit/port, actual VM identity.

stpa_analysis.controller: Manual-test preparation and bounded service launcher
stpa_analysis.control_action: Start only identified read-only test service and present exact candidate to the operator

ucas.context: No candidate identity or guide is provided.
ucas.constraint: Require candidate/run identity and manual acceptance instructions.

ucas.context: A test endpoint mutates production or navigation jumps to production.
ucas.constraint: Restrict test listener to read-only homeostasis routes and preserve its origin.

ucas.context: An old fence or changed source is used during startup.
ucas.constraint: Recheck active task, workspace/runtime epoch and immutable candidate before effects.

ucas.context: An abandoned manual instance consumes resources indefinitely.
ucas.constraint: Supervised named unit, no automatic restarts, bounded lifetime, memory and CPU.

decision.summary: Use a separately identified read-only Tailnet test listener on latest combined source; verify native/UI behavior and give a repository-local user guide.
alternatives: Replace production4100 now: rejected because production gates remain held.
Leave operator with localhost overrides: rejected because remote manual access remains awkward.
Build and expose bounded test-only instance with exact origin and candidate: selected.
counterevidence: Production currently returns503 and legacy generic homeostasis content.
Prior source had12 native ABI test failures; no global admission inferred.
assumptions: Current request authorizes a separate manual-testing instance.
No subagents, no new dependencies, preserve shared default and peers.
decision.forecast: The retained scoped UI contracts should work after binding the latest package; broader native failure may remain.
decision.falsifier: Any test route grants execution, navigation targets production, or claimed runtime differs from the prepared package.
acceptance: Scoped native and UI tests pass at candidate
Direct Tailnet GUI access and same-origin navigation
Real/test/unavailable modes and bounded stream updates
TUI snapshots and manual user guide available
Exact runtime unit/run/candidate and bounded cleanup recorded
decision.rollback: Stop only the named new test unit after identity check; retain prior package and production unchanged.
decision.reviewer: Author verification; human acceptance and independent admission remain unrun.
decision.budget: One local worker; no subagents or new dependencies;1GiB test unit,2CPU,4-hour maximum lifetime; bounded browser checks.
residuals: Production integration and complete system admission remain separate.
Tailnet-only read access is not public or cross-tenant authentication.
decision.supersedes: New manual-testing request; prior RUN50 task remains closed.
